chapters.title: Wardchar Trial 1
chapters.blurb: A cleansing line sweeps the world on a fixed cadence. Fire does not ask who is guilty; there is a narrow gap, and the wise learn where it opens. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 5, proposer mutation).
chapters.text:
Wardchar Trial 1: lancetblue 0 [0..23], pump 0 [0..6]
  [0] surge: my lancetblue += 1
  [1] glide: my pump += 3
  [2] kindle: their lancetblue += -2
  [3] erode: their lancetblue += ((their action == 1) ? -7 : -1)
  [4] ward: their lancetblue += ((their action == 0) ? -3 : 0); my lancetblue += ((their action == 0) ? 1 : -1); my pump += 3
  each round: my lancetblue += 1
  ends: (my lancetblue >= 17) => I win; after 21 rounds higher 'lancetblue' wins

chapters.title: Wardchar Trial 2
chapters.blurb: A cleansing line sweeps the world on a fixed cadence. Fire does not ask who is guilty; there is a narrow gap, and the wise learn where it opens. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 5, proposer mutation).
chapters.text:
Wardchar Trial 2: char 5 [0..26], humor 3 [0..6], lancetblue 0 [0..10]
  [0] sever: their char += ((their action == 1) ? -3 : 0); my char += ((their action == 1) ? 1 : 0)
  [1] erode: my char += 3
  [2] tether: their humor += 3
  [3] surge: my char += 1
  [4] glide: their char += ((their action == 4) ? -4 : -1); their humor += 3
  [5] siphon: my char += 3; my humor += 2
  each round: my char += 1
  ends: (my lancetblue >= 10) => I lose; (my char >= 20) => I win; after 19 rounds higher 'char' wins

chapters.text:
Wardchar Trial 3: lancetblue 5 [0..26], ledger 3 [0..6], char 0 [0..10]
  [0] kindle: their lancetblue += ((their action == 1) ? -3 : 0); my lancetblue += ((their action == 1) ? 1 : 0)
  [1] siphon: my lancetblue += 3
  [2] surge: their ledger += 3
  [3] ripple: my lancetblue += 1
  [4] fracture: their lancetblue += ((their action == 4) ? -4 : -1); their ledger += 3
  each round: my lancetblue += 1
  ends: (my char >= 10) => I lose; (my lancetblue >= 20) => I win; after 19 rounds higher 'lancetblue' wins

tagline: Three trials of the Wardchar. Learn each law, then outplay the adaptive rival.
